subject: integration
name: ENS names
summary: Orivon's ENS resolver: reads a .eth name's contenthash and records through ENS's Universal Resolver over the Ethereum nodes the person ordered, Helios first, at the newest verified block. Only a proving node's answer counts as proof; another node's still resolves, marked unproven. An offchain resolver sends the browser to a gateway its contract names; only that contract's check stands behind the data. Not Level 4: it works only through the person's Ethereum node, and by default one beacon server's outage stops every name. Nodes and gateways see the name. Judged here by its publisher.
